findings.resolution: Do not land the task while either leg is red. The orchestrator should take the placement decision the executor measured and recommended (move 'expand all', a table action, and the Sort select, an ordering, out of .sectools into the phases table's head) as a follow-up fix task. It should declare plugins/audit/scripts/report/_report_page.py, tables.css and the pins in tests/test_render_report.py (pr8 and the sortpick markup pins), and rerun the browser gate on acme, demo-large and the live render to exit 0. Do not relax LAPTOP_BAR_LINES.rest or take the one-pixel density step; the executor measured both and rejected them.

findings.issue: The field-sizing rule is a second, structurally-selected rule (.sectools>span>select) that does work the shared picker rule '.viewpick select,.sortpick select{' at tables.css:114 already exists for. Its selector was chosen to keep pr8's spelling count at 2 (the executor's note: ':is(.viewpick,.sortpick)' turned pr8 red, then it was rescoped). It is also wrapped in an @supports that changes nothing: a browser without field-sizing drops the unknown declaration anyway. The selector is tied to the markup's shape, so any future span-wrapped select in the bar silently becomes content-sized.
findings.resolution: Add 'field-sizing:content' to the existing shared '.viewpick select,.sortpick select{' declaration block in tables.css, with no @supports. Then one rule styles both pickers, which is the property pr8 guards, and the structural selector goes away. tables.css must be declared, which the fix task in finding 1 needs anyway.

preExisting.issue: pr8 holds 'the sort select is styled by the SAME rule as the view select' by counting the substrings '.sortpick' and '.viewpick'. Any rule reaching the select by another spelling (an id, a structural selector, as this diff shows) bypasses the count. So a copy that drifts from the shared rule stays green.
preExisting.resolution: Assert the property in the browser: the computed padding/font/field-sizing of #audit-sort and #audit-view are equal. Or keep the substring count, but also forbid any other selector matching a select inside .sectools.
